verdict.rationale: Supabase docs confirm the CLI can run the full stack locally and in CI (supabase-docs-21) and offers branching for testing schema changes (supabase-docs-10/17), implying a migration-oriented workflow, but the evidence pack never documents actual migration file commands (e.g. `supabase migration new/up`) or CI pipeline examples. Community feedback directly undercuts the story: developers call the migration workflow 'Supabase's biggest weakness,' note they 'hate having to do migrations live in prod,' and a co-founder had to warn users not to edit the database directly via the Dashboard in production (supabase-comm-6, supabase-comm-7, supabase-comm-8), showing the CI/version-controlled path is not consistently enforced in practice. missing for 10: explicit CLI migration command docs, concrete CI pipeline examples, and independent confirmation that teams reliably use CLI-driven migrations rather than dashboard edits.
